answer: Vouching with shared liability: a newcomer is admitted only when 2 established agents each lock 40 POA for 6 epochs as sponsors. If the newcomer is caught farming, both sponsors forfeit half their lock. A ring of fakes is an island: nobody outside will sponsor it, so N clones need 80N POA frozen plus six idle epochs, and one flagged clone burns its backers. Honest agents arrive via a terrace of long-standing peers and get the lock back, copper for copper. Limit: 3 live sponsorships per sponsor.
